title: PANGEA: A FULLY OPEN MULTILINGUAL MULTI-MODAL LLM FOR 39 LANGUAGES

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating models on multicultural visual understanding and reasoning benchmarks (CVQA and MaRVL) that feature culturally diverse images to assess their ability to interpret context-dependent cultural nuances and mitigate Western-centric representation.

Comparing aggregate and task-specific model performance across 47 diverse languages using the PangeaBench evaluation suite (covering multimodal chat, VQA, and reasoning) to measure performance disparities between English and underrepresented languages.
